title: HullQ BoatModel Identity v0.2
description: BoatModel identity contract superseding v0.1. Removes authoritative free-text manufacturer_name and brand_name fields; replaces with explicit Brand relationship records (brand_relationships). Model aliases are now entity-scoped typed IdentityAlias records rather than plain strings. All other BoatModel semantics from v0.1 are preserved.

id.description: Stable opaque HullQ BoatModel ID, independent of display name.

canonical_name.description: Canonical model name. Must not be mutated by normalization.

aliases.description: Entity-scoped typed model name aliases. Supersedes the plain-string aliases array from v0.1.

items.description: Embedded Brand relationship. boat_model_id is omitted here because it is always the enclosing BoatModel id; omitting it prevents contradictory cross-ID claims. The standalone BRAND_MODEL_RELATIONSHIP_SCHEMA.v0.1 retains both IDs for cross-entity use.

id.description: Stable opaque relationship ID for independent addressing.

brand_id.description: Reference to the Brand entity ID.

brand_relationships.description: Explicit Brand relationships. May be empty when evidence is insufficient. Supersedes free-text manufacturer_name and brand_name from v0.1.

boat_design_ids.description: IDs of BoatDesign generations belonging to this model lineage.
